title: Constant Vorticity Bounds, the BKM Integral, and Quadratic History Growth: Two Definitional Identities Checked in Lean 4
description: Lean 4 + Mathlib (v4.30.0-rc1) note: with bkmIntegral M T := M*T and history M T := M*M*T, two theorems hold by rfl, illustrating that under a constant vorticity bound the BKM integral MT is finite while the quadratic history M^2 T grows linearly. No Navier-Stokes equations, integrals or blow-up criterion are formalized; no claim toward Fefferman (C) or (D). 2 theorems, no sorry, standard axioms only. The attached paper states exactly these results.
